source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT c.api_call_id, c.source_id, s.source_name, c.call_key,
       c.base_url, c.relative_url,
       s.landing_container, c.landing_folder, c.landing_file
FROM   ctl.ApiCall c
JOIN   ctl.IngestionSource s ON s.source_id = c.source_id
WHERE  c.is_active = 1 AND s.is_active = 1
ORDER  BY c.source_id, c.api_call_id;
